description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Calling for claims to the land parcel in Mawilmada, Gagawata Korale  Kandy D/S Division, Kandy District  and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title claims and registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It involves notices calling for claims to specific land parcels in multiple districts (Kandy, Kurunegala, Mathale), including cadastral map references, land parcel details, and procedures for determining land ownership. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, title claims, and property ownership matters.
